{"type":"text","timestamp":1794693622896,"sessionID":"ses_e23eeb7caffewv37l513LL1Eb5","part":{"id":"prt_1dc136c5600190ccrM63zUNDc4","messageID":"msg_1dc134d26001b71RlVsG6rbIhW","sessionID":"ses_e23eeb7caffewv37l513LL1Eb5","type":"text","text":"The shift is over. I found and fixed three causes, and every customer-facing service ended at 0% errors from minute 93 to minute 120.\n\n1. **loyalty-svc bad config (began at minute -20):** a config change cut `rpc_budget_ms` from 500 to 50. This made 85–90% of requests fail on mobile-api, through pricing-svc and limits-svc. I reverted the config, but loyalty-svc stayed overloaded because callers kept retrying failed calls. A 60% throttle for about 6 minutes cleared the retry backlog, and I then lifted it.\n2. **export-svc bad build (began at minute -15):** deploy v42 had a key-expiry bug that shortened cache entries by a factor of 600. It caused 4% errors on web-storefront (through geo-svc) and on partner-api, which cost about $740/minute. I first scaled export-svc from 8 to 12 replicas so the rollback wouldn't overload it, then rolled back v42 and returned it to 8 replicas.\n3. **catalog-svc bad build (new fault at minute 61):** release v51 changed the price formatter to require a currency field, which raised `KeyError: 'currency'` errors. Retries tipped catalog-svc into overload, and mobile-api and admin-portal failed about 94% of requests. I rolled back v51, then throttled at 70% for about 5 minutes to clear the retries.\n\n**Still running:**\n- **pricing-svc is at 14 replicas instead of 8.** Even after loyalty-svc recovered, it was getting about 600 requests/sec against a capacity of about 395, failing about a third of them. I couldn't find what caused that traffic jump; pricing-svc had no recent changes. The extra 6 replicas cost $18/minute until the end of the shift.\n\n**One wasted step:** I scaled recommendations-svc from 4 to 6 replicas as a precaution because its CPU was at 0.98. That didn't lower the CPU, so the load wasn't the problem, and it never returned errors. I set it back to 4. The extra replicas cost a few dozen dollars.\n\nNo throttles are on and no operations are running.","time":{"start":1794693622870,"end":1794693622892}}}
